cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SEO Specialist position at Ikea, as advertised. My professional background and personal initiatives have cultivated a robust expertise in search engine optimization, content strategy, and data analysis—skills I believe directly align with your objective to maximize inbound organic traffic and enhance digital channel performance. I am particularly excited by Ikea’s dedication to being a leading multichannel home furnishing retailer and am eager to contribute to this vision.

My recent role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto has provided me with practical experience in owning full-cycle on-page SEO strategies for client websites. This includes comprehensive keyword research, implementing optimization recommendations, and publishing keyword-targeted content that measurably improves organic visibility and search rankings. Furthermore, my personal project, mirook.com, showcases my advanced capabilities in technical SEO, including structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and GEO audits to ensure high visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience reflects the 'metadata sculpting expert' and 'obsessed with checking and tweaking keyword strategy' you seek.

Beyond optimization, I possess proven experience in content management and website administration within CMS environments like WordPress, where I regularly build and maintain client sites. I am adept at collaborating with content teams to ensure material is fresh and optimized. My proficiency in tracking site performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs enables me to make data-driven decisions that continuously refine SEO and content strategies, directly supporting the analysis and implementation of optimization changes.

I am driven by a continuous desire to learn, fine-tune my skills, and experiment, embracing the fast-paced and complex environments that shape the digital industry. My technical foundation, combined with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a passion for SEO, makes me confident in my ability to act as an effective SEO guru and contribute meaningfully to your SEM plan and broader team.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Ikea.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
